candidate.rationale: The captured history contains only the qualified baseline: cell_area_um2=161954, setup_slack_ns=0.19292, hold_slack_ns=0.114491, zero slew/cap/fanout violations, and energy_j DOT64=2.293945631906608e-7, GEMM8=1.7792685987008622e-6, CONV3=1.1542462882162743e-6. This untried combination retains its physical configuration and timing-oriented abc_area=0 because setup headroom is limited. Enable both correctness-qualified actions: exact signed 18-bit reduction targets redundant arithmetic area and switching; multiply operand isolation targets switching outside request acceptance. Isolation adds gates and input delay, and synthesis may already remove some redundant width, so gains remain hypotheses. Retain utilization=40, density=0.55 and repair_margin=0; shrinking the floorplan alone does not improve the objective, and baseline electrical checks do not justify additional repair overhead. Evaluate Q=(cell_area_um2/161954)*geometric_mean(candidate energy_j/baseline energy_j) across DOT64, GEMM8 and CONV3 only after physical_qualified, measurement_qualified and rank_eligible checks pass. Report actual cell area, all workload energies, area_ratio, energy_ratio, score, setup/hold slack, electrical violations, annotation coverage, failure_classes and elapsed costs; retain failures and the best qualified result. Energy comparisons remain Liberty-model estimates from zero-delay post-route activity and extracted SPEF, with no silicon or glitch-power claim. No candidate EDA or measurement has yet been performed.
